residual_risk: Prompt injection through hostile content remains probabilistic: mediation reduces exposure but cannot eliminate it.
Tool annotations are advisory hints and tokens stay powerful, so the review quality of grants bounds this surface.
Audience-bound identity shrinks stolen-credential value, but a persuaded agent still spends real credentials within its grant.
Egress allowlists constrain destinations, not content, so exfiltration through an allowed channel remains possible.
Approval gates scale poorly with volume: consequential-but-routine mutations risk gating fatigue.
Explicit approval catches visible self-grants, but incremental environment drift between reviews can accumulate.
